method: Fresh real keyboard, pointer and touchscreen UI runs with read-only state observations, no injected game progress. Per-game source reports retained.
checks: Three authored 3D holes load; pre-start action buttons cannot move the ball or add strokes
Actual canvas targeting and a weak slider shot roll the real ball a short distance, slow by surface resistance, and cannot auto-complete the distant hole
Pause and reload precisely restore a moving golf ball position, quaternion, linear/angular velocity, direction, strength and stroke count
Space works while the strength slider retains focus; the restored lateral shot actually strikes an authored boundary and rebounds through sphere–triangle collision
Hole 1 completes only after the rigid ball falls below the authored cup opening
Hole 2 completes only after the rigid ball falls below the authored cup opening
Hole 3 completes only after the rigid ball falls below the authored cup opening, after real uphill travel
All three distinct holes contribute real strokes, per-hole bests and a final completion record
Replay restores the first tee and keeps every best score and the completion record
390-pixel touch controls adjust power and launch a real stroke without horizontal overflow
QA storage is isolated; no normal saves, missing assets or browser errors
Six real scheduled trains load with original authored Train Kit models and move on their actual incoming rail centerlines
Both red entry signals hold real trains at exact independent stop lines, with no motion or premature arrival count
Actual 3D signal-post click releases the western train, red restores for following trains, and an occupied block physically locks the route switch
The chosen bay switch produces actual curved outgoing train motion before reaching any station; travel alone is not counted
Pause freezes distances and time; actual refresh restores exact train positions, fixed route, signals, shared occupancy and timetable
Real switch-ring click changes the path to the forest station; independent north signal release uses that path and only actual western arrival scores
Read-only dispatch planning and real switch/signal buttons route all six actual trains to their own two distinct destinations and record completion
Replay really resets six trains and both red signals while retaining the gallery completion
Intentionally wrong switch sends the north train along the bay track, and only real arrival at that incorrect station fails the task
Intentionally simultaneous green signals cause actual train-unit proximity inside the shared track and a physical-distance collision failure
390 px actual touchscreen selects the projected signal post, the train advances on the selected route, outside controls remain usable and there is no horizontal overflow
Actual authored assets load without browser errors; QA remains separate from normal save keys
Actual perspective fishing scene loads eight existing authored GLB assets; intro does not advance the fishing state
Real controls choose throw direction and force; clicking the projected water target updates a real world-plane landing point
Real premature lift during waiting fails before a fish has fully bitten
Float visibly twitches before dipping underwater; ignoring the finite strike window causes a real missed bite
Continuous real reeling raises tension, bends the rod and snaps the line before the fish reaches shore
Holding actual slack control too long lowers tension and produces a lost hook
Actual pause/save/reload freezes and restores the current hooked fish, float position, line distance, tension, rod bend and strike history
Read-only tension solver uses only real J/C holds to bring the short-burst trout physically within 0.8m of shore
Second fish has visibly stronger sustained pull; real reeling/slacking lands the bass and only two actual catches complete the short task
Completed fishing ledger survives reload, and replay clears only the current fishing task while retaining completed gallery history
390px mobile renders full scene above a separate control row; actual touch casting, timely lift and held reeling work, and pause clears/disables held inputs
Only QA saves are written; zero page errors or missing GLB/assets
Illustrated cannon bases and barrels load separately over an editable 281-sample terrain; pre-start sliders cannot change play
Actual keyboard-adjusted sliders accept space to fire with slider focus; continuous gravity/wind trajectory and pause/reload retain the in-flight shell without double fire
Both sides actually launch; impact changes ground samples and round wind changes after the opponent resolves
Read-only ballistic planning and real angle/power keyboard input create actual blast damage to the other cannon
Repeated actual aimed shots finish the duel with finite opposing armor and recorded gallery completion
Completed save reloads; this duel replays while preserving the completed gallery record
Real missed shots permit the opposing AI to exhaust player armor; restart restores the whole terrain and armor
390px has no overflow; visible touch actions adjust angle and power and launch a real shell
Only QA-prefixed storage is written; all runtime art loads and no browser error occurs
40 form cards and 40 choices per selector expose real playable entries with zero pending cards
Mini golf × train dispatch loads real child games and pauses the other player in both focus directions
Fishing × artillery loads real child games and pauses the other player in both focus directions
49 gallery entries include all four new games and all nine original worlds
Both new comparisons stack at 390px with no parent or child horizontal overflow
All four standalone games actually start and pause by touch at 390px
QA remains separate from normal progress and all comparison/standalone assets load without browser errors
